task.text: Two kinds of message times two channels is four classes. A third channel makes six.

Refactor with a **bridge** so message kinds and channels vary separately. `Messages.alert(channel, problem)` and `Messages.digest(channel, items)` must keep returning messages whose `deliver(to)` output is unchanged, including the SMS cut-off.

items: Add `interface Channel` with `String send(String to, String text)`, implemented by `Email` and `Sms` (Sms owns the cut-off).
Replace the four combination classes with `Alert(Channel, String)` and `Digest(Channel, List<String>)`.

checks.title: Long SMS messages are still cut
No class per kind and channel
Alert and Digest accept any Channel
Messages never name a concrete channel

hints.text: Two things vary independently: what is said (alert, digest) and how it travels (email, SMS). Inheritance multiplies them. Keep one of them behind a reference instead.

Make the delivery mechanism a `Channel` interface with `Email` and `Sms`. `Message` holds a `Channel`; `Alert` and `Digest` build the text and hand it to `channel.send`. `Messages` maps names to channels.
